goal: Make the native desktop frontend significantly faster while preserving exact behavior parity with original ERPNext, using PR #9 differential/oracle evidence plus hypothesis-driven differential testing
grill_summary: Interview resolved: EBS means original ERPNext behavior. PR #9's Playwright-vs-Slint differential verifier and authoritative ERP readbacks are the oracle; missing behavioral coverage must be added rather than weakening parity. User explicitly chose current-session Devin SWE-2.1 for implementation and review, with external cloud/deep review disabled and human merge mode. Single shard may modify the native desktop frontend, catalog/index/ERP adapter code, verification/performance harnesses, fixtures/contracts, and concise experiment records. Non-goals: no upstream ERPNext/Frappe core edits, no financial/inventory semantic changes, no Tauri/Electron/WebView return, no production hardware claims. Acceptance: produce a measured significant improvement (at least 30% lower p50 latency or startup time in a dominant local frontend hot path, with no measured hot-path regression beyond 5%), preserve ERPNext parity through differential and authoritative checks, extend hypothesis/property or differential regression coverage for changed behavior, and document rejected hypotheses.
